title: Equipment Rental
description: No dedicated schema. StudioDoc.equipment (added this session) covers gear display for the booking flow; no rental-specific transaction/listing model exists. RESOLVED 2026-08-12 (grounded Explore audit, was flagged "genuinely unknown"): confirmed NOT a standalone flow — "rental" is just one of six filter tabs inside the mocked Marketplace browse screen (see `marketplace` above). Its "Rent This Gear" confirm button only sets a local success banner with a fabricated request ID ("#REN-5982") — no backend write of any kind. StudioBookingDoc.selectedEquipment/addons have zero references anywhere in the app; unrelated free-text "addons" notes exist in Studio Booking's own configure-session screen, not this flow. No separate flow entry is warranted going forward.
